user.title: Connect to Administrationsservice Fyn
user.description:
Log in at [{url}]({url}). Open the browser developer tools, go to **Application → Session Storage**, select `{storage_key}`, and copy the `refresh_token` field from the JSON value.

Alternatively, copy the `sso_refresh_token` cookie.

The refresh token is exchanged for a short-lived access token and is renewed automatically. It rotates on every refresh, so do not reuse an old value.

Only the customer profiles linked to your ASFyn login are read. If water or district heating is missing, link those customer numbers in the ASFyn portal first.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Administrationsservice Fyn
reauth_confirm.description: The stored login is no longer valid. Log in at [{url}]({url}) and paste a fresh `refresh_token` from `{storage_key}`, or a fresh `sso_refresh_token` cookie.

error.invalid_auth: The refresh token is invalid or has expired. Copy a fresh `refresh_token` from the session storage or a new `sso_refresh_token` cookie and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Administrationsservice Fyn API. Try again later.
error.no_customers: The login succeeded, but no customers were found on this account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
